purpose: Teach: 理性/排水/導い/促し/細部/巧み/相関/ヒロイン

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、容疑者に、絶対、理性、絶対、を、絶対、訴え、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this seriously — appealing to reason with the suspect, and we appreciate your understanding.
lines.style: Measured and professional. Even pacing. The cadence of someone used to formal statements. Slightly formal register, but genuine beneath the protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、地下、絶対、排水、絶対、管、絶対、警察、絶対、調査、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the police did investigate the underground drainage pipes in this case — thank you for that.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Careful diction. The tone of someone processing new information while listening. Respectful, earnest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者を、本気で、絶対、導いた、絶対、警察官、絶対、表彰、絶対、しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've commended the officers who guided the victim through the investigation.
lines.style: Direct, measured statement. Slight emphasis on 'commended' — note taken of the right action. Professional warmth, not effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 市民に、本気for、絶対、自首を、絶対、促した、絶対、活動、絶対、警察、絶対、進められたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the department encouraged citizens to come forward with information — that's important work.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the statement. Curious uptick at the end, like he's learning the scope of their efforts. Warm without flattering.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。証拠の、本気で、絶対、細部、絶対、警察、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're verifying every detail of the evidence carefully.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. The voice of someone committed to precision. No rush, no shortcuts. Quiet confidence in thoroughness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の、本気で、絶対、巧み、絶対、な、絶対、ごまかし、絶対、警察、絶対、見抜かれたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect was clever with their deception, but our investigators saw through it.
lines.style: Slight acknowledgment of the suspect's cunning — respect for the difficulty. Then a quiet note of pride in the catch. Even tempo, no gloating.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件間の、本気で、絶対、相関、絶対、警察、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're continuing to analyze the correlations between the cases.
lines.style: Professional continuity. Forward-looking tone. The sound of ongoing work, not finished work. Calm, methodical pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の、本気で、絶対、ヒロイン、絶対、的、絶対、勇気、絶対、警察、絶対、賞賛されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The victim showed real courage — the kind that took heroic action — and we've acknowledged that.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Slight lift on 'heroic' — genuine admiration. Slower than usual, as if giving the statement weight. Respectful finality.
